keyword: mixer pump or pump only purchase

title.en: The Order Says Mixer or Pump-Only Before Xingtai Quotes
title.zh: 邢台报价前，订单要写明搅拌或只泵送

description.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists two mixer pumps and a separate set of pump-only trailers. The purchase sentence has to say which family you are buying.
description.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台列出两台搅拌泵，以及另一组只泵送的拖泵。采购这句话必须写明你买的是哪一类。

h1.en: State Mixer or Pump-Only in the First Line
h1.zh: 第一行写明搅拌或只泵送

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai will not infer a mixer from a 0.4 m³ hopper. Electric 40, Electric 50, Diesel 40, Diesel 50 and Diesel 60 also print 0.4 m³ and do not list a mixer motor. The electric mixer lists 45 kW plus 14 kW. The diesel mixer lists 4108 / 66–75 kW and three stone rows. If the site will receive concrete that is already mixed, order a pump-only path. If the machine must mix and pump, order a mixer path. Send that choice to [/en/contact/](/en/contact/). Mixing plants are not on either list. No price is printed.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械（邢台）不会从 0.4 m³ 料斗推断出一台搅拌泵。电动40、电动50、柴油40、柴油50和柴油60也印 0.4 m³，并且不列搅拌电机。电动搅拌泵列出 45 kW 加 14 kW。柴油搅拌泵列出 4108 / 66–75 kW 和三行石子。如果现场收到的混凝土已经拌好，就订只泵送的路径。如果机器必须又搅拌又泵送，就订搅拌泵路径。把这个选择发到 [/zh/contact/](/zh/contact/)。两类清单里都没有搅拌站。没有印价格。

body.en: [/en/products/mixer-pumps/](/en/products/mixer-pumps/) leads to the two machines. The electric and diesel pump hubs are the pump-only lists.
body.zh: [/zh/products/mixer-pumps/](/zh/products/mixer-pumps/) 通向这两台机器。电动和柴油分类是只泵送的清单。

body.en: Do not add a batching-plant name. Do not add a mixer motor to Electric 40 because the main kilowatts match.
body.zh: 不要加上搅拌站的名称。不要因为主千瓦相同就给电动40加上搅拌电机。

body.en: Aggregate, distances and power type stay in the note after the family word.
body.zh: 骨料、距离和动力形式写在类别词之后。

question.en: Can one trailer be both families?
question.zh: 一台拖车能同时属于两类吗？

answer.en: Only the two mixer pages say they mix and pump. A pump-only page does not.
answer.zh: 只有两张搅拌泵页写明又搅拌又泵送。只泵送的页面没有这样写。

question.en: Is the diesel mixer on the diesel hub?
question.zh: 柴油搅拌泵在柴油分类里吗？

answer.en: It has the mixer hub. Diesel 40 remains the pump-only 4108 page.
answer.zh: 它在搅拌泵分类。柴油40仍然是只泵送的 4108 页。

question.en: Does hopper size choose the family?
question.zh: 料斗大小能选定类别吗？

answer.en: No. 0.4 m³ appears on both families.
answer.zh: 不能。0.4 m³ 在两类里都出现。

alt.zh: 搅拌泵一体机，由河北品锦机械厂家制造，邢台
